# attribution url

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:attributionUrl`](gmeow-attributionUrl.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry the URL the displayed attribution credit should link to ([cc:attributionURL](http://creativecommons.org/ns#attributionURL)) — the reuser's link target for the credit line.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for the credit text itself (that is [`gmeow:attributionText`](gmeow-attributionText.md)) or the licence-acquisition page ([`gmeow:acquireLicensePage`](gmeow-acquireLicensePage.md)).

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:attributionUrl`](gmeow-attributionUrl.md) on the asset alongside [`gmeow:attributionText`](gmeow-attributionText.md) so a reuser can render the credit as a link.

### Examples

- ex:photo [`gmeow:attributionUrl`](gmeow-attributionUrl.md) "https://janedoe.example/portfolio"^^[xsd:anyURI.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#anyURI.)
